title: What is Nabis Capital Cannabis Invoice Factoring?
summary: Most cannabis brands aren't short on revenue. They're short on liquidity. When delivered product sits on net-30, -60, or -90 terms, that capital is tied up in your retailer's payment timeline, and the downstream costs compound across every outstanding invoice on your books. Nabis Capital is an invoice financing program that pays brands on qualifying invoices within 1 business day, with approval rates above 90% in California and 80% in New York. No bank relationship required. No personal guarantee. Nabis handles collections and assumes retailer credit exposure.
